name: TIME
doc: Global time since the engine has started, in seconds. It repeats after every 3,600 seconds (which can be changed with the rollover setting). It's affected by time_scale but not by pausing. If you need a TIME variable that is not affected by time scale, add your own global shader uniform and update it each frame.

name: PI
doc: A PI constant (3.141592). A ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter and amount of radians in half turn.

name: TAU
doc: A TAU constant (6.283185). An equivalent of PI * 2 and amount of radians in full turn.

name: E
doc: An E constant (2.718281). Euler's number and a base of the natural logarithm.

name: FRAGCOORD
doc: Coordinate of pixel center. In screen space. xy specifies position in viewport. Upper-left of the viewport is the origin, (0.0, 0.0).

name: SCREEN_PIXEL_SIZE
doc: Size of individual pixels. Equal to inverse of resolution.

name: REGION_RECT
doc: Visible area of the sprite region in format(x, y, width, height). Varies according to Sprite2D's region_enabled property.

name: POINT_COORD
doc: Coordinate for drawing points.

name: TEXTURE
doc: Default 2D texture.

name: TEXTURE_PIXEL_SIZE
doc: Normalized pixel size of default 2D texture. For a Sprite2D with a texture of size 64x32px, TEXTURE_PIXEL_SIZE = vec2(1/64, 1/32)

name: AT_LIGHT_PASS
doc: Always false.

name: SPECULAR_SHININESS_TEXTURE
doc: Specular shininess texture of this object.

name: SPECULAR_SHININESS
doc: Specular shininess color, as sampled from the texture.

name: UV
doc: UV from the vertex() function. For Sprite2D with region enabled, this will sample the entire texture. Use REGION_RECT instead to sample only the region defined in the Sprite2D's properties.

name: SCREEN_UV
doc: Screen UV coordinate for current pixel.

name: SCREEN_TEXTURE
doc: Removed in Godot 4. Use a sampler2D with hint_screen_texture instead.

name: NORMAL
doc: Normal read from NORMAL_TEXTURE. Writable.

name: NORMAL_TEXTURE
doc: Default 2D normal texture.

name: NORMAL_MAP
doc: Configures normal maps meant for 3D for use in 2D. If used, overrides NORMAL.

name: NORMAL_MAP_DEPTH
doc: Normal map depth for scaling.

name: VERTEX
doc: Pixel position in screen space.

name: SHADOW_VERTEX
doc: Same as VERTEX but can be written to alter shadows.

name: LIGHT_VERTEX
doc: Same as VERTEX but can be written to alter lighting. Z component represents height.

name: COLOR
doc: COLOR from the vertex() function multiplied by the TEXTURE color. Also output color value.
